scenes.hook: When you ask an A I a question, the answer does not always come from a distant server.
scenes.idea: Local A I runs a downloaded model on your own phone or computer. Cloud A I processes requests remotely.
scenes.demo: A local app might summarize a sample note without sending that note to a model server.
scenes.compare: The tradeoff is hardware. Your memory and processor limit which models run comfortably.
scenes.takeaway: Do not assume every feature stays offline. Check the app, downloads, and network settings.
scenes.close: Which task would you keep local? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
